execution_rules.decision_to_entry: closed 1m bar t -> available t+59999ms -> enter next open t+60000ms
execution_rules.time_cap: market exit on horizon bar close if neither stop nor target hit
execution_rules.gap_veto: entry vetoed if open gap from decision close > 0.25 * ATR

candidates.economic_rationale: Trend adoption across multiple scales: 4h structural trend filtered by EMA20/50 and slope; 1h structural trend confirmation; 15m non-chase entry with 2 consecutive bars of aligned taker buy volume pressure.

math_formulation.long_entry: (4h_close > 4h_EMA20 > 4h_EMA50) and (4h_EMA20 - 4h_EMA20[3] > 0) and (1h_close > 1h_EMA20) and (15m_return < 1.5*15m_ATR) and (15m_signed_taker_ratio > 0.15 for last 2 bars)
math_formulation.short_entry: (4h_close < 4h_EMA20 < 4h_EMA50) and (4h_EMA20 - 4h_EMA20[3] < 0) and (1h_close < 1h_EMA20) and (15m_return > -1.5*15m_ATR) and (15m_signed_taker_ratio < -0.15 for last 2 bars)

candidates.falsification_criteria: Net bps <= 0 under 44 bp stress roundtrip, profit factor < 1.15, or failure across equal-weighted calendar years.

candidates.economic_rationale: Persistent order flow imbalance: 3 consecutive 15m bars with sustained signed taker ratio > 0.10 (or < -0.10) accompanied by volume > 1.2x 20-bar average, aligned with 4h EMA20 > EMA50 trend regime.
candidates.falsification_criteria: Taker pressure fails to sustain drift beyond 44 bp roundtrip cost; net bps <= 0 or trade count < 100.

candidates.economic_rationale: Breakout and retest acceptance: 4h 20-bar Donchian channel breakout within last 12h, followed by a pullback retest touching within 0.5 * 1h ATR of the breakout level, followed by immediate 15m re-affirmation with positive taker flow.

math_formulation.long_entry: (Recent 4h breakout of 20-bar high) and (15m_low <= 4h_prev_high + 0.5*1h_ATR) and (15m_close > 4h_prev_high) and (15m_signed_taker_ratio > 0.10)
math_formulation.short_entry: (Recent 4h breakout of 20-bar low) and (15m_high >= 4h_prev_low - 0.5*1h_ATR) and (15m_close < 4h_prev_low) and (15m_signed_taker_ratio < -0.10)

candidates.falsification_criteria: Chop and false retests cause repeated stop outs, yielding negative stress net bps.

candidates.economic_rationale: Volatility expansion momentum: After volatility compression (1h ATR(14) / ATR(56) < 0.75), an expansion bar triggers with ATR expansion > 1.25x and price breakout of 20-bar 1h channel, entry gated by chase limit (< 1.0 * ATR).
candidates.falsification_criteria: Post-expansion mean reversion causes drawdown > 12% or negative net returns under stress costs.

candidates.economic_rationale: Cross-session momentum continuation: At London open (08:00 UTC) or NY open (13:00 UTC), if the preceding 2 1h bars showed strong unidirectional momentum with above-average volume (> 1.2x) and aligned flow, enter for 8h continuation.

math_formulation.long_entry: (hour in {8, 13}) and (last 2 1h bars: close > open and vol > 1.2 * 1h_vol_SMA20 and signed_taker_ratio > 0.10)
math_formulation.short_entry: (hour in {8, 13}) and (last 2 1h bars: close < open and vol > 1.2 * 1h_vol_SMA20 and signed_taker_ratio < -0.10)

candidates.falsification_criteria: Session opens result in mean-reverting traps ('fakeouts') rather than sustained trend continuation.

candidates.economic_rationale: Secular 24h trend riding: Strong 4h trend (EMA20 > EMA50, ADX > 25), cumulative 4-hour signed taker flow > 0, shallow pullback entry on 15m bar touching 1h EMA20.

math_formulation.long_entry: (4h_EMA20 > 4h_EMA50) and (4h_ADX > 25) and (cumulative 4h signed taker volume > 0) and (15m_low <= 1h_EMA20 <= 15m_high) and (15m_close > 1h_EMA20)
math_formulation.short_entry: (4h_EMA20 < 4h_EMA50) and (4h_ADX > 25) and (cumulative 4h signed taker volume < 0) and (15m_low <= 1h_EMA20 <= 15m_high) and (15m_close < 1h_EMA20)

candidates.falsification_criteria: 24h horizon suffers deep intra-trade drawdowns and fails 12% max MTM DD limit, or has net bps <= 0.
